recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Any future change should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or by FHIR-I review of datatype-short-string/canonicalresource-short-description guidance, not by changing the core Requirements resource.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core R5 request to add a short description capability for Requirements. The accepted resolution was to add shortDescription 0..1 string as an extension on CanonicalResource, not to add a native Requirements.short element.
initial_application: Core commit 5689da8ab51a6cbf3ad81dac36ba7ef6b96a1c38 applied the issue by adding source/canonicalresource/structuredefinition-extension-canonicalresource-short-description.xml and registering it through a CanonicalResource implementation guide/list entry. Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the extension from core with the message 'remove extensions from R5 source'.
additional_context: Requirements is active in the current core build and uses the CanonicalResource template, so the accepted extension mechanism covered Requirements without a bespoke Requirements element. In /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, canonicalresource-short-description exists as a retired/deprecated Extension Pack artifact that points to datatype-short-string. Later Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-51245 created datatype-short-string as the active generic extension for shorter equivalents on string and markdown elements and deprecated canonicalresource-short-description.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined core branch. Reintroducing the canonicalresource-short-description StructureDefinition into core would duplicate the Extension Pack, and adding a Requirements.short element would contradict the accepted FHIR-39060 application and later generic-extension direction.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR-extensions decision replacing the canonical-resource-specific short-description extension with the generic datatype-short-string extension.
